name: Western Sydney University Opportunity Scholarship
summary: Equity scholarship for Western Sydney undergraduates facing hardship who show academic potential.
key: $7,500 per year up to three years (full-time, or part-time equivalent).
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible NZ citizen
Live in or did the HSC in Western Sydney
Minimum ATAR of 80 (current students GPA of 5)
how: Apply through UAC; shortlisted applicants may need to submit a written statement
catches: No dates on the page; see the WSU Equity Scholarship page
